annotations.title: Create a node from SVG markup

description: Creates a node from an SVG string in Figma. Useful for icons and custom graphics. Returns unboundChildren — a list of child nodes that need DS variable bindings. You MUST apply figma_update_node (op: "fill") to every unbound vector and figma_update_node (op: "text_style" then op: "fill") to every unbound text. Leaving unbound children breaks DS compliance and light/dark mode.

fillVariable.description: DS variable path for fill override (applied to ALL child vectors uniformly).

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Horizontal sizing mode. Use FILL for charts inside auto-layout containers so they stretch to the container width.

strokeVariable.description: DS variable path for stroke override.

name: figma_create_svg
